_comment: DEMO CONTENT for a portfolio project. The clinic, the doctor and the patients are invented. Review and replace every line before this is used with real patients. Spoken fields use contractions on purpose: long forms are the clearest sign of a machine on a phone call.
_schedule_note: `schedule` is the single source of truth for both the slot grid and the spoken opening hours. Change it here and the agent's answers and its bookings move together.
address: Second floor, Sunder Chambers, Lokhandwala Road, Andheri West, Mumbai 400053
doctor_credentials: MBBS, MD in General Medicine, with eighteen years in practice
services: General consultation for fever, infections, aches and everyday illness
Follow-up visits and review of ongoing treatment
Blood pressure, diabetes and thyroid monitoring
Health check-ups and routine blood tests
consultation_fee: The consultation is six hundred rupees. A follow-up within fifteen days is three hundred.
payment_methods: We take cash, UPI and all the usual cards at the desk.
insurance: We don't do cashless insurance at the clinic. We'll give you a proper receipt and prescription so you can claim it back yourself.
visit_advice: It helps if you bring any earlier prescriptions, test reports and a list of anything you're already taking.
walk_in_policy: We do keep a little room for walk-ins, but you might wait a while. An appointment is much quicker.
reports_policy: Test reports usually come back the next working day, and the desk will message you when they're ready.
greeting_inbound: Thanks for calling Aarogya Family Clinic. This is Nova. How can I help you?
greeting_outbound: Hello, this is Nova calling from Aarogya Family Clinic. Is now an alright time?
greeting_reminder: Hello, this is Nova from Aarogya Family Clinic, just calling about your appointment. Is now an alright time?
